description: Evaluation set for the XAI clinical RAG assistant. known_item: questions written about one specific paper (paraphrased, not copied from titles) -- the app should rank that paper highly. topics: broad questions; a retrieved paper counts as on-topic if its title+abstract matches the pattern (keyword-based 'silver' labels). off_topic: questions the app should refuse.
